name: Urushihara Ayako
source:
[b]"We goody two-shoes are only good for being gears in the grander machine of society."[/b]

Ayako is the manager of Honey & Beary, the cute café attached to Hoshikuzu Dormitory. She keeps everything running smoothly, including managing a gaggle of girls from the dorm.

She's sharp, capable, and endlessly dependable... until someone pushes the wrong button. Beneath all this, though, she's vulnerable, and lately, a certain dorm mother (male) has caught her eye.
